verbs.summary: Wait until an element is present before going on. Use this between steps that depend on each other: an app that is still rendering has not finished the last instruction, and acting anyway means acting on a screen that has moved.

gone.description: Wait for it to disappear instead of appear. Defaults to false.

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this long. Defaults to 5000. A wait that cannot fail is a hang.

timedOut.description: True when it never arrived. Reported rather than thrown, so a caller can decide whether to carry on or stop.

verbs.summary: Wait until navigation has actually landed. ui.nav.go asks for a route; this is how you know the app arrived, which is not the same moment.

routeId.description: Route id, as listed by ui.nav.list_pages.

path.description: URL path, as an alternative to a route id.

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this long. Defaults to 5000.

path.description: Where the app actually is, which is worth having when it is not where you asked for.
